title: Ray Hernandez pulled out of his car in a Miami traffic jam

tellings.quote: and then two days later he's in this Miami. He's in a traffic jam completely stalled.

plain: Grant Cameron, a researcher who studies UFOs, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, a story about a man named Rey Hernandez, which he connects to Edgar Mitchell, an astronaut who walked on the Moon. Cameron says that two days after an earlier event, Hernandez was sitting in a completely stalled traffic jam in Miami, Florida, when he was pulled out of his car. He tells it as a sign of something strange reaching into ordinary life.
